why.title: Why OYB
why.teaser: When external support creates movement, but not lasting change
why.p1: Many organizations bring in consultants, frameworks, or transformation programs to create movement. These efforts often generate energy and activity while they are in place. But once the support is gone, the energy often fades with it.
why.p2: Organizations now have internal roles that were once filled by consultants, yet what is still often missing is a shared structure and rhythm that keeps learning and progress moving forward.
why.p3: OYB closes that gap through a structured way of working with insight, reflection, and action — helping teams align, learn, and adjust over time.

how.title: How OYB works
how.teaser: From insight to action — with visible results over time.

0.title: Start in the right place
0.description: Begin with one team or several, depending on where you want to create impact.

1.title: Launch your first assessment
1.description: Gather structured input from the people involved.

3.description: OYB helps identify patterns, strengths, and development needs.

5.description: Use guides and workflows that support focus, follow-through, and continuous development.

6.title: Make development part of everyday work
6.description: Create regular space for reflection, learning, and improvement in day-to-day work.

7.title: Create structure for progress
7.description: Turn insight into priorities, priorities into action, and action into real progress.

8.description: Use shared visualizations and materials that help people understand the bigger picture and their role in it.

9.title: Follow up with a new assessment
9.description: Make progress visible, get new recommendations, and continue from a stronger position.

who.title: Who it’s for
who.teaser: For leaders, teams, and consultants working to create stronger, more sustainable organizations
who.intro: Designed for leaders seeking clarity, teams working in complexity, and consultants who want to create lasting impact together with their clients over time.

leaders.title: Leaders
leaders.desc: For leaders who want to create better conditions for the organization to perform, improve, and stay aligned over time. OYB helps make priorities clearer, strengthen alignment, and show where friction and progress exist across the organization.
leaders.quote: Finally, a way to see where we actually stand.

people.title: People & Culture
people.desc: For People & Culture teams working to strengthen social sustainability, motivation, and long-term engagement. OYB makes patterns in leadership, collaboration, inclusion, role clarity, and everyday working conditions more visible. It helps connect employee experience with practical actions that support well-being, contribution, and long-term performance.
people.quote: It connects our people strategy to daily reality.

teams.title: Teams
teams.desc: For teams working in complex environments where ownership, trust, and coordination matter. OYB helps teams clarify their purpose, responsibilities, and dependencies, making it easier to take initiative, prioritize well, and work with greater autonomy. It also supports a leadership approach focused on enabling progress, removing obstacles, and helping the team perform well together.
teams.quote: We know what to focus on next.

consultants.title: Consultants
consultants.desc: For consultants who want to strengthen their offer and play a more strategic role in client development. OYB gives consultants a structured way of working with insight, analysis, facilitation, and continuous follow-up. This makes it easier to provide high-value support, guide development over time, and spend less energy on manual administration and process coordination.
consultants.quote: My work has impact that lasts beyond the engagement.

methodology.title: Our Method
methodology.teaser: A structured way to turn insight into real improvement over time
methodology.p1: OYB helps organizations turn insight into clearer priorities, shared understanding, and meaningful improvement over time.
methodology.p2: Many organizations already collect valuable information through surveys, assessments, and performance indicators. The challenge is rarely a lack of insight. The challenge is turning that input into shared understanding, clear priorities, and improvements that people can actually see. When that does not happen, response rates often decline over time.
methodology.p3: OYB supports this work by combining recurring assessments, AI-based analysis, and structured team activities. The method is grounded in established research and proven theories and practices in leadership, governance, and organizational learning.
methodology.fiveIntro: To make patterns, friction, and development needs easier to understand, OYB groups organizational capabilities into five areas:

strength.title: Strength
strength.desc: the clarity, stability, and foundations that support performance.

execution.title: Execution
execution.desc: the ability to turn priorities into coordinated action and results.

resilience.title: Resilience
resilience.desc: the capacity to handle pressure, uncertainty, and setbacks without losing direction.

agility.title: Agility
agility.desc: the ability to learn, adjust, and respond to change.

endurance.title: Endurance
endurance.desc: the ability to sustain focus, energy, and development over time.

methodology.fiveOutro: Together, these areas help organizations understand where they are strong, where friction exists, and where improvement efforts can make the biggest difference.
methodology.modelIntro: OYB is a model that helps organizations clarify direction, put strategy into practice, and follow progress over time. It consists of four connected steps:

insight.title: Insight
insight.desc: The organization gathers and analyzes information about the factors that affect productivity, sustainability, and long-term performance.

alignment.title: Alignment
alignment.desc: Leadership and teams build a shared understanding of the direction ahead and the priorities that matter most.

execution.title: Execution
execution.desc: Strategy is translated into priorities, initiatives, and concrete execution.

learning.title: Learning
learning.desc: The organization reflects on progress, captures lessons, and adjusts the work as it moves forward.

methodology.modelOutro: Over time, this creates a stronger rhythm for prioritization, collaboration, adaptation, and delivery.

orgFitness.p1: OYB approaches organizational development as a form of collective training.
orgFitness.p2: Just as athletes improve through regular training, follow-up, and feedback, organizations strengthen their capabilities by making time for reflection, shared understanding, and action.
orgFitness.p3: This strengthens the organization’s ability to understand complexity, make clear strategic choices, work effectively across teams, and deliver meaningful results over time.

methodology.foundationsIntro: OYB’s analysis and ways of working are grounded in established research and proven theories and practices in leadership, governance, and organizational learning. The method draws in particular on four complementary perspectives:

agile.title: Agile principles
agile.desc: Shorter cycles, clear priorities, transparency, and continuous improvement.

systems.title: Systems Thinking
systems.desc: A focus on the connections between structures, behaviors, and outcomes rather than isolated parts

collective.title: Collective Intelligence
collective.desc: Using the organization’s combined experience, perspectives, and knowledge to build deeper understanding and better decisions together.

learning.title: Organizational Learning
learning.desc: Creating the conditions for reflection, learning, rethinking, and improvement over time.

methodology.sustainedTitle: From insight to improvements that last

sustained.p1: The purpose of OYB is not only to generate insight, but to help organizations turn it into improvements that last over time.
sustained.p2: By combining research-based analysis, shared reflection, and a structured way of working, OYB helps organizations create clearer priorities, stronger follow-through, and improvements that hold over time.

introduction.heading: 1. Introduction
introduction.p1: Univise AB (“we”, “us”) is committed to protecting personal data in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable data protection laws.
introduction.p2: We maintain governance, security, and risk management processes designed to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of personal data processed through the OYB platform.
introduction.p3: This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, store, and protect personal data in connection with:

roles.heading: 2. Roles and Responsibilities
roles.intro: Depending on context, OYB acts as:

controller.label: Data Controller
controller.text: for website visitors, customer contacts, and marketing communication

processor.label: Data Processor
processor.text: when processing personal data on behalf of customer organizations within the OYB platform

roles.processorNote: When acting as Data Processor, processing is governed by a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) in accordance with Article 28 GDPR.

legalBasis.heading: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.intro: We process personal data based on:
legalBasis.note: Legitimate interests may include maintaining platform security, preventing fraud, and improving service performance.

list.0: Deliver and operate the OYB platform

ai.heading: 6. AI-Based Processing and Transparency
ai.intro: OYB uses AI-based analytical models to generate structured insights and recommendations on priorities.

list.0: Supports analysis at the organizational level
list.1: Does not perform automated decision-making with legal or similarly significant effects on individuals
list.2: Does not replace human judgment in leadership or governance
list.3: Is not used to determine employment or contractual decisions

ai.conclusion: AI outputs are advisory and should be interpreted by humans.

security.heading: 7. Information Security
security.intro: OYB maintains technical and organizational security measures aligned with recognized information security principles, including those reflected in ISO/IEC 27001 and Article 32 of the GDPR.

list.1: Secure cloud infrastructure within the EU (Google Cloud Platform)
Separation of development, staging, and production environments

hosting.heading: 8. Hosting and Data Location
hosting.p1: All customer platform data is stored within the European Union using Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure located in EU data centers.
hosting.p2: Data is not intentionally transferred outside the EU/EEA unless appropriate safeguards are in place.

subprocessors.heading: 9. Sub-Processors
subprocessors.intro: OYB engages carefully selected sub-processors for infrastructure and service delivery, including:
subprocessors.note: All sub-processors are subject to contractual data protection and confidentiality obligations. OYB maintains oversight of sub-processor compliance.

retention.heading: 10. Data Retention

list.0: For the duration of an active subscription
list.1: For 30 days following termination to allow data export
list.2: In backup copies retained for up to 90 days
list.3: For longer where required by law

retention.note: Once the applicable retention period has expired, data is securely deleted or anonymized.

incident.heading: 11. Incident Management and Breach Notification
incident.intro: OYB maintains internal procedures for incident detection, response, and mitigation.
incident.notice: In the event of a personal data breach affecting customer data:

list.0: Customers will be notified without undue delay
list.1: Notification will comply with GDPR Article 33 and 34 requirements
list.2: Appropriate remediation measures will be taken

transfers.heading: 12. International Transfers
transfers.intro: If personal data is transferred outside the EU/EEA, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place, including:

rights.heading: 13. Data Subject Rights
rights.note: Requests may be submitted to privacy@oyb.app. Individuals may lodge complaints with the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY).

cookies.heading: 14. Cookies
cookies.p1: OYB uses cookies and similar technologies. Please refer to our Cookie Policy for more information.

updates.heading: 15. Updates to This Policy
updates.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in legal, technical, or operational requirements.
updates.p2: The latest version will always be available at oyb.app.
